This vignette demonstrates a professional end-to-end MSI-MS2 workflow with:

1. imzML loading into `msi_dataset`
2. MGF-based MS2 integration and preprocessing
3. MS1-MS2 matching
4. pseudo-MS2 inference via spatial correlation
5. spectrum and spatial visualization

## Load packages

```{r}
library(msidataset)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Resolve package demo paths

```{r}
resolve_demo_dir <- function() {
  p <- system.file("data/demo data", package = "msidataset")
  if (nzchar(p) && dir.exists(p)) return(p)

  pkg_root <- system.file(package = "msidataset")
  p2 <- file.path(pkg_root, "data", "demo data")
  if (nzchar(pkg_root) && dir.exists(p2)) return(p2)

  stop("Could not locate demo data directory via package paths.")
}

demo_dir <- resolve_demo_dir()
imzml_file <- file.path(demo_dir, "03-total ion count.imzML")
mgf_files <- c(
  file.path(demo_dir, "CHCA-neg-ms2-10ev_MSMS191.0200.mgf"),
  file.path(demo_dir, "NEDC-neg-ms2-10ev_MSMS130.0600.mgf"),
  file.path(demo_dir, "CHCA-neg-ms2-10ev_MSMS306.0700.mgf")
)
```

## Full workflow

The code below is intentionally set to `eval = FALSE` to keep vignette checks
stable and lightweight across environments. You can run it interactively.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# 1) Load MSI and convert to msi_dataset
obj <- read_imzml(path_1 = imzml_file, path_2 = tempdir(), peak_align_tolerance = 10)

# 2) Import MS2 and preprocess fragments
obj <- mutate_ms2(
  object = obj,
  path = mgf_files,
  ms1.ms2.match.mz.tol = 10,
  precursor_tolerance = 0,
  remove_precursor_peak = TRUE
)

# 3) Inspect MS2 annotation in variable_info
head(variable_info(obj)[, c("variable_id", "mz", "has_ms2", "ms2_id", "ms2_type")])

# 4) Extract one precursor spectrum
target_var <- variable_info(obj)$variable_id[which.min(abs(variable_info(obj)$mz - 191.02))]
ms2_actual <- extract_ms2(obj, variable_id = target_var, ms2_type = "actual")

# 5) Infer pseudo-MS2 with spatial correlation
obj <- infer_pseudo_ms2(
  object = obj,
  variable_id = target_var,
  correlation_threshold = 0.8,
  correlation_method = "spearman",
  spatial_smoothing = TRUE,
  smoothing_k = 1,
  fragment_intensity_threshold = 0.1,
  replace_existing_pseudo = TRUE
)
ms2_pseudo <- extract_ms2(obj, variable_id = target_var, ms2_type = "pseudo")

# 6) Plot MS2 spectra
p_ms2_actual <- plot_ms2(obj, variable_id = target_var, ms2_type = "actual")
p_ms2_pseudo <- plot_ms2(obj, variable_id = target_var, ms2_type = "pseudo")

# 7) Spatial maps for precursor and fragment
p_spatial_precursor <- plot_spatial(
  object = obj,
  feature = target_var,
  feature_type = "variable_id",
  facet_by = c("feature")
)

selected_fragment <- if (!is.null(ms2_pseudo) && length(ms2_pseudo$fragments) > 0) {
  ms2_pseudo$fragments[which.max(ms2_pseudo$intensity)]
} else {
  ms2_actual$fragments[which.max(ms2_actual$intensity)]
}

p_spatial_fragment <- plot_spatial(
  object = obj,
  feature = selected_fragment,
  feature_type = "mz",
  tolerance_ppm = 20,
  facet_by = c("feature")
)

# 8) Optional: MS2 network visualization
g <- build_ms2_network(obj, variable_id = target_var, ms2_type = "pseudo")
p_net <- plot_ms2_network(g)
```
